name: Basis LAN Discovery
description: Finds Basis servers on your local network. Servers on the same LAN appear in the Servers panel by themselves, with no address to type, and a hosted session can be shown to the LAN from the host settings. Uses mDNS/DNS-SD. Install it into the Unity project to browse and announce, and into a Basis Server through the Basis Package Manager to announce dedicated servers.
author: Toys0125
